properties.name: nplus1.detector.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable N+1 query detection. Default: true.

properties.name: nplus1.detector.threshold
properties.description: Minimum number of duplicate queries to flag as an N+1 violation. Default: 3.

properties.name: nplus1.detector.mode
properties.description: Detection mode: LOG (production-safe), THROW (for tests), or SILENT (metrics only). Default: LOG.

properties.name: nplus1.detector.application-packages
properties.description: Base packages of your application for stack trace filtering. Helps identify the code origin of N+1 queries.

properties.name: nplus1.detector.capture-stack-traces
properties.description: Whether to capture stack traces for each query. Disable for maximum performance in production. Default: true.

properties.name: nplus1.detector.report-format
properties.description: Report format: CONSOLE (pretty), JSON (structured), or BOTH. Default: CONSOLE.

properties.name: nplus1.detector.actuator-enabled
properties.description: Whether to expose the /actuator/nplus1 endpoint. Default: true.

properties.name: nplus1.detector.metrics-enabled
properties.description: Whether to export Micrometer metrics. Default: true.

properties.name: nplus1.detector.proxy-datasource
properties.description: Wrap the DataSource to capture accurate query timings. Default: true.

properties.name: nplus1.detector.max-history-size
properties.description: Maximum violations to keep in memory for actuator/metrics. Default: 1000.

properties.name: nplus1.detector.include-code-examples
properties.description: Whether to include code examples in console report output. Default: true.

properties.name: nplus1.detector.severity.medium
properties.description: Minimum duplicate queries for MEDIUM severity. Default: 4.

properties.name: nplus1.detector.severity.high
properties.description: Minimum duplicate queries for HIGH severity. Default: 10.

properties.name: nplus1.detector.severity.critical
properties.description: Minimum duplicate queries for CRITICAL severity. Default: 50.

properties.name: nplus1.detector.exclude-paths
properties.description: URL path patterns to exclude from detection (Ant-style). Default: /actuator/**, /swagger-ui/**, /v3/api-docs/**.

values.description: Throw exception on N+1 detection (for tests/dev)
Detect and record but don't log (metrics only)
Pretty console output with emoji and formatting
Structured JSON for log aggregation (ELK, Datadog)
Output both console and JSON formats
